definitions.explanation: Paper manufactured from recycled waste paper rather than virgin pulp.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{名刺|めいし}→名刺：01090_meishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{再生紙|さいせいし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}られている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: This business card is made from recycled paper.

examples.japanese: {再生紙|さいせいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{貢献|こうけん}できる→貢献する：21682_koukensuru⟧。
examples.english: Using recycled paper can contribute to the environment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{印刷|いんさつ}→印刷：01844_insatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すべて{再生紙|さいせいし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}えた→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧。
examples.english: We switched all in-house printing to recycled paper.

notes:
Paper made from waste paper or recycled materials. A compound of ⟦{再生|さいせい}→再生：04442_saisei⟧ (recycling; regeneration) and {紙|し} (paper). Common in discussions about environmental sustainability and corporate responsibility in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再生紙|さいせいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use recycled paper
- {再生紙|さいせいし}⟦{配合|はいごう}→配合：16196_haigou⟧⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧: recycled paper content ratio
- {再生紙|さいせいし}100%: 100% recycled paper
- {再生紙|さいせいし}⟦トイレットペーパー→トイレットペーパー：23785_toirettopeepaa⟧: recycled toilet paper

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{古紙|こし}→古紙：21849_koshi⟧: waste paper; used paper (the raw material)
- ⟦リサイクル→リサイクル：04624_risaikuru⟧: recycling
- ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧やさしい: environmentally friendly
